# Web Fetch

The Apify actor [`apify/web-fetch`](https://apify.com/apify/web-fetch) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.30**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Download any web page by URL and convert it to clean Markdown, plain text, HTML, and other formats. Automatically renders JavaScript and works around bot blocking. The Actor provides a real-time API for quick response times.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Fetch $0.0015, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/web-fetch) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-web-fetch@0.0.30#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      url: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | yes |  | URL — The URL to fetch. Only `http://` and `https://` schemes are supported; others are rejected. |
| `formats` | string[] |  |  | Output formats — The Actor converts the fetched content to the requested format(s). A format that doesn't apply to the content type returns `null`; if none of the requested formats apply, the run fails. The Input form is prefilled with `markdown`; clear it to auto-select `markdown` for HTML/PDF, `te |
| `headers` | object |  |  | Custom headers — Custom HTTP headers to send to the target URL, as an object of header names and values, e.g. `{ "Accept-Language": "fr-FR", "Authorization": "Bearer TARGET_SITE_TOKEN" }`. |
| `wait` | integer |  |  | Wait after load (milliseconds) — Milliseconds to wait after the page loads, for content that shows up late. From 1 to 60000. Setting it renders the page in a real browser, so content loaded by JavaScript is included. Rendered requests are slower. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
